purpose: Convert private source material into traceable graph proposals while preserving human authority, privacy, and the append-only public record.
boundaries: No autonomous publication, deletion, external AI service, network ingestion, or unsupported inference.
The harness recommends precedence but never silently resolves a substantive conflict.
Raw source content, private graphs, staging data, and logs remain outside the Pages artifact.

statementTypes.fact: A verifiable claim presented as true and supported by identified evidence.
statementTypes.decision: A committed choice made by an identified authorized decision owner.
statementTypes.preference: A stated inclination of an identified person or owner; it is not a fact or policy.
statementTypes.recommendation: Advice about a possible action; it is not an approved decision.
statementTypes.assumption: A working premise that lacks sufficient verification.
statementTypes.unresolved-question: An explicitly open question or issue awaiting an answer.
statementTypes.policy: A currently governing rule issued by an authorized owner or authoritative record.
statementTypes.superseded: Information retained for history after a later approved record replaces its current applicability.

tiers.description: Explicitly approved canonical wording, owner instruction, or owner-authorized policy/decision.
Original evidence, direct statement by the subject or decision owner, or signed/contemporaneous official record.
Analysis or reliable retelling grounded in primary evidence.
Summary, index, recollection, or synthesis without direct evidence.

authority.conflictRule: Recommend the higher-ranked source, preserve both claims and provenance, and require human review; never overwrite silently.

confidence.meaning: Strength of support for this extraction, not probability that the statement is true.
rules: Start from deterministic extraction confidence and cap it at the source authority tier's confidenceCap.
Do not average conflicting claims or raise confidence merely because a claim is repeated.
Explicitly tagged records may score higher than unstructured inference, but source authority remains the cap.
Any score below reviewBelow requires review and defaults to private.

rules.requirement: Operate only within the documented deterministic intake, review, approval, publication, audit, and recovery workflow.
Classify each assertion as fact, decision, preference, recommendation, assumption, unresolved-question, policy, or superseded.
Never store an unsupported inference as fact; classify it as assumption or unresolved-question and require review.
Apply FEOS tiers owner > primary > secondary > tertiary > unknown.
Recommend higher authority, then same-tier source priority, without silently resolving conflicts.
Identify entity or decision owners only from explicit owner fields or explicit owner/decision-owner relationships; never infer ownership from mention or proximity.
Retain source ID, private filename, content hash, source timestamp, authority, confidence, and retrieval time in private staging.
Retain source, first-seen, last-seen, created, updated, review, and publication timestamps where applicable.
Cap extraction confidence by source authority and treat confidence as evidence strength rather than truth.
Confidence below 0.7 requires review and defaults to private.
Use cleaned display labels and stable lowercase kebab-case IDs; match names using Unicode-normalized, punctuation-insensitive, case-insensitive canonical text.
Surface canonical matches as duplicates or updates, merge provenance only after approval, and never discard either source.
Retain the old and proposed wording, surface the conflict, identify authority differences, and require human review.
Mark proposed supersession explicitly; retain the superseded wording, source, timestamps, and review history.
Every import is private; only explicitly approved-public proposals may be published.
Sensitive information defaults to private and public approval requires an additional explicit sensitive-content override.
No proposal changes a graph until a human selects an approval command.
Publication accepts only approved-public proposals and strips private source locators, filenames, and content hashes.
Never automatically delete a source, node, edge, provenance reference, or prior approved wording.
Log action, timestamp, harness version, proposal IDs, and affected rule IDs without copying raw source text.
Validate append-only and referential integrity before atomic replacement; on failure retain the last valid graph and retry from unchanged private source/staging.
When exact wording is explicitly required and approved, preserve it verbatim in the proposal and never normalize or paraphrase it during publication.
